Hi Jeff,

Yes, we can do that, but let me give you the dates first so you can decide.

Your B30 on Shop···· is batch 1 and ships October 15, so it's about a week out. The Magic M. 40T that's open right now is Batch 7, and that one isn't in stock today, it's a pre-order that ships by November 30. You can follow both shipments on their way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

On the money, the 40T is $100 less than the B30 line on your order, and $100 back goes to your account as store credit, which applies at checkout on your next order. Your free Power K. stays on the order either way.

So it's 30 TH/s next week, or 40 TH/s at the end of November with $100 in credit. Just reply yes if you want the swap and I'll make the change today and send you the updated order. If you'd rather have the $100 back on your card instead of as credit, say so and I'll pass that to a colleague to sort out.

Hi Jeff,

You are right, and I am not going to argue the point. You asked a clear question a month ago, it was answerable then, and we let it sit. I am sorry.

On the swap itself, here is the honest position. Your B30 box was labelled on November 6 and is sitting at our Chattanooga warehouse waiting for the carrier. I cannot swap a parcel that already has a label on it without risking you being sent both units, so I am not going to run it and tell you it is done when it is not. What has to happen is the parcel being pulled back before it leaves, or sent back to us if it has already gone, and then the 40T put on your order in its place. That is a person at the warehouse, not something my side can do.

So that is exactly what I have asked for, with your yes on the record. Georges picks it up Monday at 10am ET and will write to you on this thread with the confirmation.

Two things you should know before Monday. The Magic M. 40T batch open now is Batch 10, which is a pre-order shipping by December 21, so swapping does mean waiting again. And the 40T is $100 under what the B30 line is on your order, so that difference comes back to you as well. If you would rather just keep the B30 that is already packed, tell me and I will stop the recall, no hard feelings either way.

If the parcel reaches you in the meantime, do not open it, that keeps this simple.

Sorry again for the month, Jeff.
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
